overview.description: The iShares Nasdaq 100 ETF (IQQ) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the NASDAQ 100 index. The fund tracks an index of the largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq exchange based on modified market capitalization. IQQ was launched on Jul 8, 2026 and is issued by BlackRock.
